Transcriptomic Changes in mpkCCD Collecting Duct Cells After 24 Hour Exposure to Tolvaptan

Brief methods: Cultured mpkCCD cells grown on permeable supports in the presence of the vasopressin analog dDAVP (0.1 nM) were exposed to tolvaptan (50 nM) or vehicle in continued presence of dDAVP (24 hours) before cell harvest for small sample RNA-Seq analysis as previously described (PMID: 28973931).

This website was created by Shaza Khan, Lihe Chen, and Mark Knepper. Contact us with questions or comments: knep@helix.nih.gov. Database updated: September 13, 2023

TPM, mRNA level in transcripts per million; Padj, Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted P-value. Click here to download data. Please cite: Khan et al. Vasopressin V2 receptor, tolvaptan, and ERK1/2 phosphorylation in the renal collecting duct. Am J Physiol Renal Physiol. 2024; 326:F57-F68. PMID: 37916285
